mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shots (id, script_id, shot_number, visual_description, video_prompt, duration_seconds, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{scriptId}, #{shotNumber}, #{visualDescription}, #{videoPrompt}, #{durationSeconds}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, script_id, shot_number, visual_description, video_prompt, duration_seconds, created_at, updated_at FROM shots WHERE script_id = #{scriptId} ORDER BY shot_number, id
